director_mandate.scout_assessment: Scout brief was decisive and largely adopted but not as authority. Its executive assessment that program is infrastructure-blocked not insight-blocked, with MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED due to paid-tier CDN, BrowserGym unavailable, and Gate0 failures, correctly framed the global decision. We adopted its stalled-or-idle reactivations: graph fix-first unit-test gate before WebArena hold-out, runtime PARK of paid-tier CDN to exploit nginx HIT substrate, physics PARK of Gate0 hunt after exhaustive 61 attempts, intel 20-sample AX longest-prefix+SHA256 recompute, and frontier pivot to mixed-channel composition. We challenged Scout where it suggested broad WebGym 292k/127k sweep or immediate paid-tier provisioning — high upside but premature before the minimal 20-sample gate passes and before honest residual-novelty accounting is validated. We delegated deep verification of WebArena-Verified v2 census and WebGym holdout diversity to Intel rather than adopting Scout's external claims as evidence. Scout's cross-lane dependency map (runtime->graph delta-repair, intel->physics Gate0, frontier->product economics) directly shaped dependencies and PARK decisions.
